reconstructed_values.midwheel_set_authority: count is manufacturer-published; diameters, pair spacing, pivots and rocker geometry are reconstructed
reconstructed_values.rear_interface_attachment_note: Machine-local reconstructed rest-pose continuity calibration. The hitch and drawbar meshes overlap the chassis and each other in the retained pose; these height ratios are visualization choices, not manufacturer-published pivot coordinates or operating limits.
reconstructed_values.neutral_material_policy: matte slate body, dark rubber, graphite running gear, clear neutral glazing, no logos or decals

unresolved_choices: Exact production track, gauge, ballast and hitch option combination
All belt, idler, drive-wheel, midwheel and track-frame profiles
Exact body panel, hood, grille, cab, glazing and service-platform surfacing
All hidden suspension, SmartRide Plus, cab, hitch and drawbar pivots and actuators

mechanical_gaps: Track belts are a rigid visual abstraction without physical lug engagement, tension, deformation, slip or soil interaction.
Hardbar, midwheel and SmartRide Plus transforms are reconstructed demonstrations and do not form a validated suspension solver.
Cab movement is a bounded visual study, not a measured sprung-mass response.
Three-point and drawbar motions omit implement mass, hydraulics, PTO driveline, hoses and verified swept-volume closure.
Cooling, engine, transmission, aftertreatment and hydraulic internals are not modeled.
